observations: Steal An Egg (95 days) leads ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, Murder Mystery 2, DONT SPLASH (11 days) and RIVALS.
Halloween moves dominate: Survive Overnight in a Mega Store rose +33 and Sniper Arena +12, while Dead Rails fell -31 and he ate them. -20 despite same-day updates.
Ten games entered, including Realistic Ragdoll Engine (16 days), A Long Flight, Survive a Million Monkeys, Home Alone: Anomalies and +1 Money Per Click.
Multi-year evergreens (60th median percentile) and the newest games (65th, n=2) lead, while 85–365-day games sit at the 21st–29th, the mid-life trough again.
patterns: More original concepts consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-013 at 77%), and solo loops consistently sit lower (H-mp-003 at 76%).
'+1' titles go with lower positions (r=-0.43) while 'Egg' titles go with higher ones (r=+0.46), carried mostly by Steal An Egg and its clones.
Higher median product prices go with more days on the chart (split at 449 R$, r=+0.44), and games updated within 12 days stay longer (r=-0.61 for days since update).
steal_defend_base leads loops by median percentile (85) and incremental_plus1 trails (14).

outliers.note: An 11-day horror obby already among the best on Most Popular, carried by a single sound rule and the Halloween horror wave.

outliers.name: [🎃] Build a Keyboard!
outliers.note: 97% likes and 32 passes yet among the weakest on the chart; a 91-day roll-and-collect game sitting in the mid-life trough (H-mp-009).

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) again lead efficiency, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Dinosaur Simulator and Jungle Life.
Steal A Pet And Ride It! rose +130, Work at a Pizza Place +116, It Hears The Water +109 and PINKIE PROMISE +100, while tower-defense games Anime Mysterious (-74) and Anime RNG Defense (-48) fell.
Efficiency climbs with age from the 6th percentile at 0–14 days to the 60th past a year.
Eleven games entered, including My Dino Empire, German Moped Days, Ride a Dragon, Ro-BassFishing and World of Stands.
patterns: Median product price above 79 R$, a premium pass above 999 R$, servers above 24, RPG genre, complexity and longer descriptions all consistently go with higher efficiency (84% each).

Steal-a-X loops (18th percentile), Survival genre and Simulation genre consistently earn lower positions for their CCU, and horror_escape loops sit at the 33rd percentile, proposed today as a hypothesis.
Roleplay hubs (74th) and story adventures (72nd) lead loops; sandbox physics (16th) trails, matching ragdoll games' reach without revenue so far.

outliers.name: Ride a Dragon [StarWeaver 💫]
outliers.note: A steal-and-hatch game that entered Top Earning with 216 developer products, the lone counter case to H-te-024; unique float-rated dragons may add collection value.

outliers.name: Ro-BassFishing
outliers.note: Entered with only 2 passes and 3 cash products priced 800–1600 R$, a niche realistic sim selling few but expensive items.

observations: Cook the Chicken (by slapping it) (+38), My Bus (+31), Paint and Hide! (+26), Fart Together and Throw Food For Animals lead young-game momentum.
Fix My Phone! (-29), Something is Wrong With My Dog (-31) and +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs (-19) fell, and Fix My Phone! later left the chart.
Twenty-two games entered, among them Banana Eats with a Hollow tag, Steal A Pet And Ride It!, Word Game [RU] and Escape The Walls.
Games 0–14 days old score the 75th median percentile against 43 at 43–84 days.
patterns: Shorter titles consistently go with higher positions (H-tt-037 at 71%), and more updates per week tend to go with higher positions (H-tt-040 at 67%, rho=+0.36).
Launching with more than 8 passes tends to go with lower positions (H-tt-032 at 67%), and creature themes tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-022 at 63%).
Descriptions asking players to join the group may go with slower climbs (r=-0.42, 8 games), proposed today.
Sandbox physics and wave survival lead loops (77th each) while simulation jobs (25th) trail.

outliers.name: Cook the Chicken (by slapping it)
outliers.note: No passes, 5 products and a 78% like ratio yet the strongest climber, a curiosity hook that counters most monetization hypotheses.

outliers.name: My Bus 🚌
outliers.note: A job sim with 189 products climbing +31, against the weak median for simulation jobs.

observations: DONT SPLASH leads ahead of Realistic Ragdoll Engine, My Small Business, Ragdoll Reality, My Bus and A Long Flight.
Secure the Waterpark rose +48, MOUSE +44, Criminal Simulator +34, Night Rider +33 and Escape The Walls +32, while Catch a Plane! (-48) and Save the Krusty Krab (-45) fell.

patterns: Luck passes consistently go with lower positions (H-uc-018 at 71%, r=-0.61), and thumbnails with text or numbers consistently rank lower (H-uc-017 at 72%).
Gameplay thumbnails (H-uc-040, 73%) and more original concepts (H-uc-039, 73%) consistently go with higher positions.

Party-minigame loops sit at the 16th median percentile, with six table-duel games (word chain, quiz, logo, pancake, face painting, truth or lie) in today's profiles; proposed today as a hypothesis, with skip products (r=-0.25) as a second.
Physics sandboxes, racing and idle tycoons lead loops (77th each).

outliers.name: 🧸 My Small Business
outliers.note: A cash-tycoon build game near the top, still the counter case to H-uc-016 and H-uc-029.

outliers.name: Fart Together
outliers.note: The weakest on the chart even as a near-identical Fart Together obby is a top Top Trending climber, suggesting the meme wave rewards the first entrant.

summary: Ragdoll physics and noise-rule horror lead the breakout charts again, and both now reach Most Popular: Realistic Ragdoll Engine entered at 16 days and DONT SPLASH is among its best at 11 days.
The Hollow, Roblox's own event hub, is on Most Popular, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming at once, and participating games such as Banana Eats tag it in their titles.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the newest games lead Up-and-Coming and Top Trending while Top Earning efficiency rises steadily with age.
Halloween events lift and drop older games across charts this week, a seasonal confounder for update and age hypotheses.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (126 entries, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (108, 2 days).
uc→te (78, 5 days), tt→te (75, 4 days), te→tt (72, 9 days) and uc→mp (67, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
